280
echo == 1. 部署 guard v1.3 ==
echo  | base64 -d > /root/azar_guard.sh.new && bash -n /root/azar_guard.sh.new && cp /root/azar_guard.sh /root/azar_guard.sh.bak_v12 && mv /root/azar_guard.sh.new /root/azar_guard.sh && echo guard13已部署
echo == 2. 部署 v4.1 ==
echo  | base64 -d > /root/remote_ctl.sh.new && bash -n /root/remote_ctl.sh.new && cp /root/remote_ctl.sh /root/remote_ctl.sh.bak_v4 && mv /root/remote_ctl.sh.new /root/remote_ctl.sh && echo v41已部署
echo == 3. 清场拉起服务 ==
pkill -f "mai[n].py" 2>/dev/null
pkill -f "opt/QQ/[q]q" 2>/dev/null
pkill -f "azar_guar[d].sh" 2>/dev/null
sleep 2
cd /root/Napcat && setsid nohup xvfb-run -a /root/Napcat/opt/QQ/qq --no-sandbox --disable-gpu --disable-software-rasterizer --disable-dev-shm-usage --js-flags=--max-old-space-size=512 > /root/napcat.log 2>&1 < /dev/null &
cd /root
cd /root/bot/bot && setsid nohup /root/bot/venv/bin/python main.py >> /root/bot.log 2>&1 &
cd /root
setsid nohup bash /root/azar_guard.sh >> /root/guard_run.log 2>&1 &
sleep 3
echo == 4. 重启worker切v4.1 ==
kill $(cat /root/.remote_pid) 2>/dev/null
sleep 2
cd /root && setsid nohup bash /root/remote_ctl.sh >> /root/remote_ctl.log 2>&1 &
sleep 40
echo == 5. 验证 ==
N=$(pgrep -fc "opt/QQ/[q]q"); echo QQ进程数: $N
pgrep -f "mai[n].py" >/dev/null && echo bot在 || echo bot不在
pgrep -f "remote_ct[l].sh" >/dev/null && echo worker在 || echo worker不在
pgrep -f "azar_guar[d].sh" >/dev/null && echo 守护在 || echo 守护不在
date "+完成: %H:%M:%S"
